The '''Reisendrelle''' is a river that runs south through [[Murandy]] and [[Lugard]]. The rebel [[Aes Sedai]] under [[Egwene al'Vere]] briefly stopped on the Reisendrelle during their march to the [[Andor]]an border. It flows into the [[River Manetherendrelle]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Reisendrelle}} The [[Storn]] and [[Armahn]] both flow into it.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Storn}}
